treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Republic of Austria for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of tax evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2006)
eif_quote: Convention between the kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the republic of Austria for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of tax evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital, signed on 19/3/2006 and entered into force on 1/6/2007.

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

However, such income from debt-claims may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the income from debt-claims the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the income from debt-claims.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Art. 28(2)(a): WHT provisions apply to amounts paid on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (EIF 2007-06-01 -> 2008-01-01). Art. 10(3): dividends paid to the other State's Government, local authority or wholly owned agency/instrumentality (incl. financial institution) exempt. Art. 11(3): interest ('income from debt-claims') exempt where payer is the Government/local authority, paid to the other Government or wholly owned agency, paid on loans under an inter-governmental agreement, or on export-promotion loans granted/insured/guaranteed by a public institution - not modelled. Both Saudi Arabia and Austria reserved the entirety of MLI Art. 8 (no 365-day holding requirement; dividend rate is flat anyway). MLI covered by both; PPT WHT effective date reused from treaty map (Art. 35(1)(a), later MLI EIF 2020-05-01). Treaty text has no protocol; no own PPT clause.
